method: pixel is noise-supported when |delta| > k*SE; SE = sqrt(s_e^2/n_e + s_l^2/n_l), s floored at 0.02; s = per-pixel std across the period's scenes (ddof=1)
framing: Scene-to-scene spread measures acquisition noise only. It cannot see seasonal, tidal or phenological differences between the periods and is itself uncertain with 2-3 scenes per period. A noise-supported pixel is not proof of real change; an unsupported one is not proof of none.

ndsi.reason: fewer than 2 scenes in a period
